title.en: Homa: Rethinking TCP for AI Clusters

excerpt.zh: Homa将AI集群网络中的TCP问题推到台前，但现有来源只有视频标题，尚不足以验证其架构、性能或“终结TCP”的实际范围。
excerpt.en: Homa puts TCP’s role in AI-cluster networking under scrutiny, but the available source offers no evidence yet about its design, performance, or scope.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Homa是这则视频主题中的核心关键词，标题直接提出一个强烈判断：面向AI集群的网络通信，可能需要重新思考TCP的角色。现有来源仅显示该视频被提交到Hacker News，尚未提供协议设计、实验结果或适用条件。
text.en: Homa is the central keyword in the video’s topic. Its title makes a strong claim: networking for AI clusters may require a rethink of TCP’s role. The available source only shows that the video was posted to Hacker News; it provides no protocol design, experimental results, or operating conditions.
What “The End of TCP” Could Mean

text.zh: “TCP的终结”可以指替代传输协议，也可能只是针对特定AI工作负载、数据中心网络或通信路径的技术取舍。仅凭标题，无法判断Homa是否试图全面取代TCP，还是解决某类集群流量中的延迟、吞吐或协调问题，因此不应把标题当作已证实的结论。
text.en: “The end of TCP” could mean replacing the transport protocol, or it could describe a narrower choice for particular AI workloads, data-center networks, or communication paths. From the title alone, it is impossible to tell whether Homa aims to replace TCP broadly or address latency, throughput, or coordination in a specific class of cluster traffic. The headline should not be treated as a verified conclusion.

text.zh: 对AI基础设施读者而言，最值得关注的不是口号本身，而是可复现的比较：Homa的工作边界是什么，与TCP相比牺牲和获得了什么，部署是否需要改变网络设备、操作系统或应用程序，以及在不同集群规模下是否稳定。来源没有回答这些问题。
text.en: For AI-infrastructure readers, the important questions are not the slogan but the evidence: What are Homa’s operating boundaries? What does it gain or sacrifice compared with TCP? Would deployment require changes to network devices, operating systems, or applications? Does it remain effective at different cluster sizes? The source answers none of these questions.

text.zh: 因此，当前可以确认的只有一个值得追踪的技术命题，而不是一项已被证明的替代方案。阅读或观看原始视频时，应优先寻找协议机制、基准测试、故障场景、兼容性说明和真实部署信息；在这些材料出现之前，对“终结TCP”的理解应保持谨慎。
text.en: What can be confirmed at this stage is a technical proposition worth following, not a proven replacement. Anyone reviewing the original video should look for protocol mechanisms, benchmarks, failure scenarios, compatibility details, and deployment evidence. Until those details are available, claims about ending TCP should be interpreted cautiously.
